home.hero: A new era of BIO CHAR for India's farmers
home.summary: Khaad Bharat brings natural BIO CHAR for Indian farmers. It is a bio fertilizer that strengthens the soil, helps save water, and supports better crop yields.
home.intro: Farming costs are rising every year, especially for fertilizer and water. Demand for BIO CHAR is growing quickly across the country because it helps keep soil fertile for longer and lowers overall farm input costs.
home.supportText: Khaad Bharat BIO CHAR helps soil hold moisture for longer, which can reduce the need for repeated irrigation. That means savings in water, diesel, and electricity.
home.biocharSummary: BIO CHAR is a natural carbon-rich material made from agricultural residue that helps improve soil quality.
biocharPoints: Helps hold essential nutrients in the soil
Makes soil lighter and more aerated
Reduces the impact of heat and dry weather
home.demandTitle: Why is BIO CHAR demand growing?
home.demandSummary: As chemical fertilizer costs rise and soil quality falls, more farmers are moving toward sustainable farming practices.
demandPoints: Support from government and agriculture projects
home.marketSummary: Khaad Bharat is a trusted source of high-quality BIO CHAR that can reach farmers directly.

weather.title: Farmer Weather Advice
weather.description: Access real-time weather analytics designed to support smart fertilization, seed sowing schedules, and water irrigation budgets.

delhi.label: North - New Delhi (NCR)
delhi.advice: Dry soil. Prioritize deep irrigation before applying Biochar. Ideal for soil preparation.

bhopal.label: Central - Bhopal (MP)
bhopal.advice: Moderate humidity. Excellent window to blend Biochar with compost for root enrichment.

patna.label: East - Patna (Bihar)
patna.advice: Heavy rain expected. Postpone open field Biochar application to prevent nutrient runoff.

amritsar.label: North-West - Amritsar (Punjab)
amritsar.advice: Good wind conditions. Safe for broadcasting Biochar. Ensure proper soil covering.

nagpur.label: West-Central - Nagpur (Maharashtra)
nagpur.advice: Dry conditions. Mix Biochar with cow dung or compost before root zone application.

lucknow.label: North-Central - Lucknow (UP)
lucknow.advice: Scattered showers predicted. Focus on mixing Biochar with soil blocks in nursery beds.
